[[Independent (college sports)|independent]] during the [[1963 NCAA University Division football season]] In their ninth season under head coach [[Tommy Prothro]], the Beavers compiled a 5–5 record and were outscored 198 to 192.{{cite web|title=1963 Oregon State Beavers Schedule and Results|publisher=Sports Reference LLC|work=SR/College Football|access-date=September 7, 2016|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cfb/schools/oregon-state/1963-schedule.html}} The team played two home games on campus at [[Parker Stadium]] in [[Corvallis, Oregon|Corvallis]], and two at
